comments.value: Considering that the website has the Friends Location stuff and updates friends correctly I am constantly surprised when I don't see the next vrchat update include any of this.
This is now possible using the Social wing included in the Quick Menu.

details: Dont you hate it when youre scrolling through your friends list trying to find someone that isnt in a private world? Well I do, so please add a tab to filter only for friends that are NOT currently in a private world (aka joinable without request).
title: Social tab for friends that are not in private worlds

voters.name: あうたあどっと＠藍夜野雑貨
